As support for [CLAIM-1316](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1316.md) the contrast fails: the new problems A names (hold-up after specialization, capture of a party's reliable commitment, control over the terms of continued cooperation) are problems of exchange and division, which Curry's account counts as its own, and a sequence of cooperation problems is still cooperation problems; the step also passes from where moral dispositions come from to what makes verdicts valid, a passage A23 §11 itself refuses.
